blazers.pulse: Skid over. Portland handled the Thunder 123-103 at home on Tuesday to get to 7-3, ending OKC's four-game win streak. The lineup shakeup paid off right away, and they get OKC again tonight at Moda.
storylines: Beat OKC 123-103: Lillard had 25 (13 in the third), Avdija added 24 points and 8 assists, and a 38-21 third quarter broke it open.
Sidy Cissoko got his first start of the season in place of Scoot Henderson and scored 17 with three threes; Henderson had 11 off the bench on 3-of-12.
SGA scored 26 but went 0-for-4 from three, and OKC was missing Jalen Williams, Chet Holmgren and Cason Wallace, so temper the celebration a bit.
Back-to-back home set: the rematch with the Thunder is Wednesday night, and there's no word yet on who starts.

timbers.pulse: Still riding the Decision Day high after the 2-0 win at Austin that locked up the No. 7 seed. Now it's a long wait: the playoff series with No. 2 FC Dallas doesn't start until Nov. 21.
storylines: Game 1 is Saturday, Nov. 21 at 1 p.m. Pacific in Frisco (Apple TV); Game 2 is at Providence Park on Nov. 28; a Game 3, if needed, is back in Dallas on Dec. 2.
Portland closed the regular season with four straight wins to finish 13-14-7 with 46 points.
Dallas striker Petar Musa (22 goals, 6 assists) is the guy to stop; Dallas topped 60 goals for the first time in club history.
Martí Cifuentes has the Timbers in the playoffs for a third straight year, and Pantemis says they've been in playoff mode for weeks.

f1.pulse: Both titles are done, so the fight is now for second: Verstappen leads Russell by 17 points with Vegas, Qatar and Abu Dhabi left. Wolff saying Mercedes wants Russell second has fans arguing about whether Antonelli will be asked to help.
storylines: Standings: Verstappen 279, Russell 262, Hamilton one point behind Russell, with 75 points still on the table.
Wolff says Mercedes wants Russell to finish second, but reports say no team-order policy has actually been confirmed.
Verstappen has outscored Russell by 90 points over the last five races, capped by his drive from 21st to 2nd in Brazil.
Las Vegas is next: qualifying Friday, Nov. 20 and the race Saturday night, Nov. 21.
